new_exclusions.unlisted_input: county of residence (Indiana county income tax)
new_exclusions.alternative_reading: The prompt places the household in Indiana but states no county, and Indiana's county income taxes (IC 6-3.6) differ by county. policyengine-us 2.38.6 computes Indiana county tax (in_county_tax) in local_income_tax at the rate of the county it assigns a household with no stated county (Adams County on policyengine-us 2.38.6). Read without a county, as policyengine-us 2.15.17 did, the household owes no county tax.
new_exclusions.note: Found in the 2026-10-10 engine upgrade (the US hub's sweep, cells_pe<ver>.md: local-tax standardization wires Indiana county income tax into local_income_tax). The alternative is the policyengine-us 2.15.17 reference.
